overall_reason: An owned, long-standing brand system (Sohne, the Stripe indigo #533afd, the ribbon gradient, detailed working product mocks in several currencies and languages, the live GDP counter, real customer stories with figures); the mechanical violet-gradient and icon-tile hits are deliberate brand assets, not defaults, though the page is very long and its lower half drifts into generic section headings.

findings.where: mid and lower section heads (tiles 1440-04 to 1440-07)
findings.evidence: T-RIVAL-NAME / T-FRESH-READER: 'The backbone of global commerce', 'Powering businesses of all sizes', 'Flexible solutions for every business model.', 'Build a foundation for your startup that enables faster growth' all stay true with Adyen or PayPal swapped in. The hero and the stats under these heads are specific; the heads are not.
findings.after: Lead with the number the section proves, e.g. 'US$1.9tn processed in 2025' as the head
findings.why: Generic heads on an otherwise specific page are where the page reads interchangeable.

findings.evidence: 2,007 words and 12 screens at 1440 (sweep); after the bento of products the page repeats the same move (heading + grey continuation sentence + cards) for startups, enterprises, platforms, developers and customer stories. T-STOCK-ORDER: logo strip, stat band, testimonial carousel, story cards, CTA and link-farm footer are present but interleaved with bespoke product graphics, so under the 7-section threshold for 'generated'.
findings.before: Six audience sections in the same heading + lede + cards form
findings.after: Collapse the audience sections into one switcher, or vary their form
findings.why: Section-template repetition (SLP-156) dilutes a strong first half.

findings.evidence: Two-tone heading device on every head: dark first sentence, grey-blue continuation ('Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue. Accept payments, offer financial services...', 'Flexible solutions for every business model. Grow your business with...'). It is a house style used consistently, so it is a choice, but it makes the h1 four lines long at 48px and pushes the CTAs to the fold.
findings.before: h1 = headline + grey 3-line lede in the same 48px size
findings.after: Drop the continuation to body size under the headline in the hero only
findings.why: Two-tone headlines are flagged as a template device (SLP-195); here it is brand, so Finish only.

strengths: Product mocks are real and detailed: terminal checkout in USD/EUR/JPY ('Pay Roastery US$5.46', 'Zum Bezahlen Karte auflegen'), a checkout with Link, Apple Pay, Affirm, Cash App; they show the product rather than describe it.
Live 'Global GDP running on Stripe: 1.74637798%' counter is ownable and falsifiable.
Customer stories carry figures and names ('Gamma expands to US$100m ARR and 70 million users with Stripe').
Ribbon gradient and indigo are long-standing brand assets; the violet-gradient cluster from the sweep is brand, not default.
not_investigated: stats band (tile 1440-04) was captured mid-animation, numbers partly faded; not judged
no 00-contract.md brief; brand ownership of the ribbon and indigo judged from general knowledge of the site
